data.name: Nathir
data.gender_notes: Nathir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nathir is derived from the Arabic word 'nathara', which means 'to warn' or 'to remind'. It is often used in the context of religious or moral guidance. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is described as a 'nathir', or a warner, to his people, urging them to follow the righteous path.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder from Allah to follow the righteous path.
data.etymology: Nathir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warner, Reminder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nathir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نثير
in_arabic.meaning: السماء الواسعة، الفضائل العديدة، النفوس المتفوقة، الشخصية العالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: النثير هو اسم عربي يأتي من الجذر الن-ث-ر، والذي يعني السماء الواسعة أو الفضائل العديدة. يعتبر هذا الاسم من أهم وأفضل الأسماء في الإسلام، ويتميز بفضائله العديدة مثل الكرم والجود والإحسان. في القرآن الكريم، يذكر الله تعالى سماء النثير في سورة البقرة آية 164، حيث يقول "فَأَخَذَتْهُ سَمَاءُ بَيضٍ فَكَوانَ يُقَزَّظُ". في الثقافة الإسلامية، يعتبر النثير اسمًا مقدسًا، ويتميز بأنه يرمز إلى الفضائل العليا والسماء الواسعة. يختار الأباء والأمهات لهذا الاسم من أجل إعطاء أبنائهم اسمًا مقدسًا ورمزًا لسمو الفضائل والأعمال الطيبة.

in_english.name: Nathir
in_english.meaning: Abundant sky, many excellent qualities, noble and superior souls
in_english.long_meaning: Nathir is an Arabic name that means abundant sky and many excellent qualities. It is considered a sacred name in Islamic tradition and is associated with nobility and superiority. In the Quran, Allah mentions the sky of Nathir in Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 164, where He says "Fathahathu Samawu Baydun Fakawan Yuzazzu". Nathir is a name that symbolizes excellence and nobility, and is often chosen by parents for their children to give them a name that reflects their high moral character and good deeds.
